name: Lower body & core — build progression
focus: Progressive lower-body strength and core stability, shoulder fully protected
notes: 3 rounds: 12x goblet squat 22kg, 10x RDL 22kg, 8x TRX Bulgarian split squat per leg (foot in TRX strap — no shoulder load), 15x banded lateral walk each direction (medium band), 8x dead bug per side (3s eccentric), 30s side plank per side (sub forearm plank if shoulder discomfort). Rest 60-75s between rounds. Warm-up: 10x BW squat, 10x glute bridge, 10x leg swing each side, 30s hip flexor hold each side. Cool-down: 45s hip flexor each side, 45s pigeon/figure-4 each side, 30s hamstring each side.
